summary: Verified the Excel-import Category/Product column-mapping fix. Backend: created xlsx files with openpyxl and imported via POST /api/import/loans-excel (month=Sep-2026) — (1) standard headers 'Category'/'Product' -> imported=2 and GET /api/loans confirms category='SECURED'/product='Home Loan' and category='UNSECURED'/product='Personal Loan' (bank/status also correct); (2) alternate headers 'Loan Category'/'Product Type' -> category='SECURED', product='LAP'; (3) alias 'Loan Product' -> product='Business Loan'. 3/3 pytest tests pass. UI: logged in as admin, MIS Board -> Add Month (2026-09) -> Import dialog -> selected Sep-2026 -> uploaded xlsx -> import succeeded (group shows '2 entries'); after expanding the Sep-2026 group the CATEGORY and PRODUCT columns render 'SECURED / Home Loan' and 'UNSECURED / Personal Loan' correctly. Cleanup: all Sep-2026 test loans deleted (DB back to 25 loans, 0 Sep-2026 remaining). One pre-existing (unrelated) UI defect found: the FIRST click on the newest month-group header is swallowed — the group only expands on the second click.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on the newest/just-imported month header does not expand the group (chevron stays collapsed); a second click works. Root cause: fetchLoans() auto-expand does setExpandedMonths(new Set([data[0].month])) which overwrites user toggles on any subsequent loans refresh, and it uses the raw loan.month value instead of the grouped month key (toMonthKey). Reproduced 3/3 times right after an import.

issues: Uses native browser <input type="month"> picker (data-testid=add-month-input) instead of a shadcn month/date picker; value must be 'YYYY-MM' which is inconsistent with the 'Sep-2026' labels used everywhere else
DATE column for imported rows shows the month label 'Sep-2026' instead of a date/em-dash when the Excel has no date column

action_items: Fix MonthlyMIS auto-expand: only auto-expand on the initial load (e.g. guard with a ref) and use toMonthKey(loan.month, loan.group_month) so a loans refresh doesn't reset the user's expanded/collapsed state and swallow the first header click
critical_code_review_comments: column_mapping now covers category/product aliases; consider normalizing headers by removing spaces/underscores (e.g. 'loan_category', 'Product  Type') so mapping is resilient rather than an ever-growing alias dict
server.py import handler is inside a >3300 line file; extract Excel import + column mapping into its own module for testability

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Category/Product display (month-expand click quirk is pre-existing)

seed_data_creation: Temporary Sep-2026 loans (TEST_User A-D, TESTUI_User A/B) created via import and deleted afterwards; DB back to 25 loans
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_import_category_product.py -v -p no:randomly (self-cleaning module fixture deletes all Sep-2026 loans). For UI, Sep-2026 must first be created via Add Month (native month input, fill '2026-09') before it appears in the import month select; month groups need TWO clicks to expand right after import due to the auto-expand bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Category/Product were dropped because df columns were never renamed from 'Category'/'Product' to 'category'/'product'; adding the aliases to column_mapping resolves it and is confirmed end-to-end at API and UI level.
